entities.name: The High Throne / Central Seat
entities.description: Mysteriorum Liber: The central seat of divine presence, positioned at the highest elevation above the Great Table.

entities.name: The Holy Table (Tabula Sancta)
entities.description: Liber Scientiae: The central square table inscribed with the 27 Enochian letters, serving as the nexus of the Four Watchtowers.

entities.name: Watchtower of Air (East)
entities.description: True Great Table: The Eastern Quadrant governing the element of Air, containing the 13x12 letter grid led by King BATAIVAH.

entities.name: Watchtower of Water (West)
entities.description: True Great Table: The Western Quadrant governing Water, containing the 13x12 grid led by King RAAGIOSL.

entities.name: Watchtower of Earth (North)
entities.description: True Great Table: The Northern Quadrant governing Earth, containing the 13x12 grid led by King ICZHICAL.

entities.name: Watchtower of Fire (South)
entities.description: True Great Table: The Southern Quadrant governing Fire, containing the 13x12 grid led by King EDLPRNAA.

entities.name: The Black Cross / Union Cross
entities.description: Tabula Recensa: The central intersecting cross separating the Four Watchtowers and binding the Great Table together.

entities.name: Archangel Michael (Sun / East)
entities.description: Mysteriorum Liber I: Prince of the heavenly host, associated with the Ring of Solomon and the Sun.

entities.name: Archangel Gabriel (Moon / West)
entities.description: Mysteriorum Liber II: Minister of the visions, associated with the lunar realm and western gates.

entities.name: Archangel Raphael (Mercury / South)
entities.description: Mysteriorum Liber II: Bearer of the Heptarchic power and divine wisdom.

entities.name: Archangel Uriel (Venus / North)
entities.description: Mysteriorum Liber I: First spirit appearing in the stone, bringer of the Sigillum Dei Aemeth.
